<plan>We are next to a table (west) and have plenty of saplings (wood) in inventory. The immediate priority is to defeat the zombie in front to get the “Defeat Zombie” achievement and continue progressing. Steps:

1. Craft a wood sword using the table (Make Wood Sword).  
2. Use the Do action to hit the zombie until it is defeated.  
3. Drink water (Do) to restore drink level.  
4. Eat the grass (Do) to restore food and later earn “Eat Plant”.  
5. Sleep when energy is low (Sleep) to get the “Wake Up” achievement.  
6. Collect wood (if not already counted) for “Collect Wood”.  
7. Place a plant near the water (Place Plant) for the “Place Plant” achievement.  
8. Explore to find stone, then collect stone (Do) and place it (Place Stone) for “Collect Stone” and “Place Stone”.  
9. Craft a wood pickaxe (Make Wood Pickaxe) and mine stone and coal.  
10. Place a furnace (Place Furnace) and smelt ore to get iron.  
11. Craft stone and iron pickaxes/swords (Make Stone Pickaxe, Make Iron Pickaxe, Make Stone Sword, Make Iron Sword) for respective achievements.  
12. Collect coal, iron, and finally diamond (Do) for “Collect Coal”, “Collect Iron”, “Collect Diamond”.  
13. Find and eat a cow (Do) for “Eat Cow”.  
14. Defeat a skeleton when encountered (Do) for “Defeat Skeleton”.  

This sequence will eventually complete all listed achievements. The first immediate action is to craft the wood sword.
